correctness.rationale: Canonical product weights at total half filling are stationary: each tree edge balances locally, while ring 10/01 counts cancel per configuration. Removing a ring bond gives E_m/(E_{m-1}+2E_m+E_{m+1}) with m=N-1. The exact nonnegative coefficient expansion of (m+1)(E_{m-1}+E_{m+1})-2mE_m has no constant or linear term, is strictly positive with at least two nonunit activities, and occupation complementation handles all weights <=1. The 2 and 1/2 leaf witness has current 7/23 vs neutral 3/10. The bound requires half of ALL sites, connected ring, positive tree edge rates and a common-sided activity family. The all-size certificate is algebraic, not merely the finite tests.
